- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations to keep Luna entertained include rotating toys, using food puzzle toys, engaging in interactive play, providing climbing structures, sensory stimulation, creating a "hunt," window perches, varying play difficulty, encouraging social interaction, and observing and adapting to Luna's preferences.
